name: NVIDIA Nemotron 3.5 Bolt E4B 4GB
attention_variant: Gemma-4-E4B hybrid: 35 sliding-window layers (512-token window, head_dim 256) + 7 full-attention layers (global_head_dim 512); 18 trailing layers reuse KV (num_kv_shared_layers)
license: OpenMDW-1.1 (card license_name openmdw-1.1; Gemma 4 base weights Apache-2.0)
notes: ADDED 2026-11-18 from the HF trending feed (trendingScore 78, 157k downloads, 510 likes). A post-train (GRPO multi-environment RL via NeMo RL / NeMo Gym) of google/gemma-4-E4B-it, released by NVIDIA as its own checkpoint, so it is a first-class record with base_model set. Card says '8B (4B effective)'; HF safetensors.total on both this repo and the BF16 parent is 7,996,156,490, and the 4B figure is Gemma 4's per-layer-embedding effective count - so params_b = safetensors total and active_params_b = the card's effective count, used as the flops proxy too (no MoE here; the FFN is dense). Serves as the card's headline artifact: this repo carries Nemotron-3.5-Bolt-E4B-Q4_K_M.gguf (4 GB, the reason for the '4GB' in the name), deployable on llama.cpp server-cuda13; the BF16 parent is nvidia/NVIDIA-Nemotron-3.5-Bolt-E4B-BF16. Hardware gate passes with room: 8.0B total at 0.5 GiB/B = 4.0 GiB, and the recommended 4-bit artifact is 4 GB on disk. KV BASIS: config.json text_config (read from the parent repo) gives 42 layers, layer_types = 35 sliding_attention + 7 full_attention (full at 5,11,17,23,29,35,41), num_kv_shared_layers 18, num_key_value_heads 2, head_dim 256, global_head_dim 512, sliding_window 512, max_position_embeddings 131,072. KV-producing layers = 42 - 18 = 24, of which 4 are full attention (5,11,17,23), so per-token growth = 2 (K+V) x 4 layers x 2 KV heads x 512 global_head_dim x 2 bytes (bf16) = 16,384 B/token, i.e. 1.00 GiB at 64k. The 20 sliding producers add 2 x 20 x 2 x 256 x 2 = 40,960 B/token but only across a 512-token window (20.0 MiB, fixed), so they do not scale with context. The card services a 64K context (input and output up to 64K) although the config allows 131,072; max_position_embeddings records the config, 64K is what the card claims. KV NOTE: 16 KiB/token is large for this size class - the sibling gemma-4-e2b-it record lands at 6,144 B/token on 3 surviving full producers; E4B cannot match that because 4 full-attention layers survive the KV-sharing cut. Benchmarks are NVIDIA's own NeMo Gym runs, so every row is vendor_claim. CONFIDENCE 0.8: table read directly off the card, no third-party reproduction exists. GAP: the base google/gemma-4-E4B-it is not a catalog record yet (only the E2B sibling is), so base_model points outside data/models.

benchmarks.name: MultiChallenge
benchmarks.config: Card 'Benchmarks' table, BF16 column; base column Gemma4-E4B-it BF16 42.08 (+11.0). Q4_K_M column 55.60 vs base 39.36. NeMo Gym harness, reasoning mode. Beats the best <=9B score already in the catalog on this test (KRAFTON Raon-1 nano 40.5) by 12.6 points, though on a different harness.

benchmarks.name: IHEval
benchmarks.config: Same table, BF16; base Gemma4-E4B-it 67.04 (+17.8). Q4_K_M 82.40 vs 66.61. NeMo Gym, reasoning mode.

benchmarks.name: IFBench
benchmarks.config: Same table, BF16; base Gemma4-E4B-it 42.84 (+20.9). Q4_K_M 64.00 vs 42.67. LOSS on the deployable artifact: Qwen3.5-4B Q4_K_M 66.67 is ahead, and the catalog already holds Granite 4.2 8B 79.33 and NVIDIA Dory 1.0 4B 79 (different harnesses).

benchmarks.name: RoleMRC
benchmarks.config: Same table, BF16; base Gemma4-E4B-it 74.62 (+6.0). Q4_K_M 79.12 vs 75.24. One of the three rows the card evaluates without reasoning mode.

benchmarks.name: GaRAGe
benchmarks.config: Same table, BF16; base Gemma4-E4B-it 34.73 (+7.9). Q4_K_M 40.73 vs 30.91. NeMo Gym, reasoning mode.

benchmarks.name: Tau2-Bench
benchmarks.config: LOSS, recorded deliberately. Same table, BF16; Qwen3.5-4B 75.06 is far ahead and the catalog's NeoHorse-1-4B records 88.46; Q4_K_M 52.32 vs Qwen3.5-4B Q4_K_M 61.74. It does beat its base Gemma4-E4B-it (38.50 bf16 / 38.72 Q4), so the agentic-tool gap is inherited rather than introduced by the post-train.

benchmarks.name: RULER (64K)
benchmarks.config: LOSS. Same table, BF16; Qwen3.5-4B 95.15 and Nemotron-3-Nano-4B 91.51 are ahead; Q4_K_M 85.76. Non-reasoning mode. Material because this record's KV is 16 KiB/token and the card only services 64K.

benchmarks.name: LongBench v2 (48K)
benchmarks.config: LOSS. Same table, BF16; Qwen3.5-4B 59.93. Q4_K_M 48.67 vs 58.28.

benchmarks.name: EQ-Bench v3
benchmarks.config: LOSS to its own base: Gemma4-E4B-it 41.17 (Q4 39.77). One of the three non-reasoning rows. The post-train spends 1.8 points of emotional-intelligence headroom to buy the instruction-following and multi-turn tool rows.
